name: Search and score developer jobs to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## 1. Configure

Add Apify Header Auth (`Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`) to every HTTP node and Google Sheets OAuth2 to the last node. Import the shared CSV header, replace the spreadsheet ID, choose explicit search terms, and keep actorBuild pinned to verified build 0.1.22. The starter explicitly uses shortlist mode at delivery score 2. Keep five jobs and the $0.10 cap for the first run.

## 2. Run and verify

The workflow starts one exact Actor build, polls only the returned run ID with a finite deadline, and rejects every terminal outcome except SUCCEEDED/0. It then reads that run's immutable dataset and key-value-store IDs—never a latest-run shortcut.

## 3. Validate and write

RUN-SUMMARY v3 or v4, result-policy counts, search provenance, scoring-v3 receipts, the $0.25 owner-provider circuit breaker, and the single $0.02 result meter are reconciled before Google Sheets. V4 shortlist rows must be scored and meet the declared delivery threshold; AI-failed rows are not written. Rows upsert by matchKey, which keeps different candidates separate. Confirm the named row in a disposable sheet before activating anything.
